statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-6732: when libxml2 validates a document against an XML Schema while parsing it (streaming XSD validation) and the document contains an internal entity reference, xmlParseReference() passes the parser context instead of the SAX user data to the characters/cdataBlock callbacks, a type confusion that crashes the application (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-6732, https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/issues/1097, fix in https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/merge_requests/411). Alpine 3.23 patched it in libxml2 2.13.9-r1 (aports commit https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/commit/d7ba2f7929f49815296140d7d7a3e98bbcce535a, listed under secfixes 2.13.9-r1 in the 3.23-stable APKBUILD). The DHI Alpine 3.23 libxml2 packages are built from that APKBUILD: 2.13.9-r0 predates the patch, and 2.13.9-r1, 2.13.9-r2 and 2.13.9-r3 carry it. This was confirmed in the shipped libxml2.so.2.13.9 on x86_64 and aarch64: in 2.13.9-r1 through 2.13.9-r3, the two characters/cdataBlock call sites in xmlParseReference() load the user-data field of the parser context as the first argument, where 2.13.9-r0 passes the context itself. The fixed version is 2.13.9-r1.
